verdict.rationale: Bun's default lockfile format bun.lock is explicitly text-based (v1.2+) and documented, replacing the binary bun.lockb, and docs market it as 'a lockfile you can read'—directly matching the story of a documented, diffable, text lockfile an agent could parse. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of agent tooling actually diffing bun.lock or third-party validation of its readability/diff-friendliness beyond vendor docs.
